source_caption:
10 Things I Hate About You (1999) is a teen romantic comedy inspired by Shakespeare’s The Taming of the Shrew. The story follows new student Cameron, who wants to date Bianca, but her strict father won’t allow it unless her older sister Kat—who hates dating—also gets a boyfriend. So Cameron pays the mysterious and rebellious Patrick to take Kat out, leading to unexpected romance.

Set in a high school environment, the film mixes humor, teenage drama, and heartfelt moments. Heath Ledger and Julia Stiles deliver memorable performances, especially in the iconic poem scene at the end. The movie became a late-90s classic and is still loved for its witty dialogue and charming love story.

source_details.synopsis: 10 Things I Hate About You is a 1999 American teen romantic comedy directed by Gil Junger (in his directorial debut) from a screenplay by Karen McCullah Lutz and Kirsten Smith. Adapted from William Shakespeare's comedy The Taming of the Shrew, it stars Julia Stiles, Heath Ledger, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Larisa Oleynik, Larry Miller, Andrew Keegan, David Krumholtz, Susan May Pratt, and Gabrielle Union. In the film, high-school student Cameron James (Gordon-Levitt) is unable to date sophomore Bianca Stratford (Oleynik) until her asocial feminist senior sister Kat (Stiles) dates, leading to Cameron recruiting bad boy classmate Patrick Verona (Ledger) to date Kat.
